name: Astrid Bjornstad
bio:
Astrid Bjornstad's motorsport journey began, unusually, in architectural design. A fascination with aerodynamics and structural integrity led her from building blueprints to race car performance analysis. After earning her engineering degree, she joined a small Swedish rally team, quickly rising through the ranks from data analyst to team manager, proving her sharp eye for detail and strategic prowess. 

Her transition to RFK Racing as Sporting Director was driven by her ambition to integrate cutting-edge technology and innovative management techniques to unlock the team's full potential. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every member feels empowered to contribute their best, ensuring every detail, from pit stop strategy to driver development, is executed with precision. Astrid is known for her relentless pursuit of perfection and her ability to see opportunities where others see obstacles.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight blonde hair with subtle highlights.
physical.description: Astrid is a striking woman of average height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a habit of rearranging items on her desk to ensure perfect symmetry.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee throughout the day.
